prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandstone canyon floor in front of the rose-red Treasury at Petra, a smooth sandy path and standard-height rock-cut doorways, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult German woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a silver miniature anvil, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough tin a square-sided cowbell hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth golden-tan skin, a cool composed look, soft rose-gold hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a lead cube-shaped block, a gold ship's anchor, a bronze miniature anvil, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum necklaces. RIGHT Physique: A tall, lean, athletic man built like a swimmer. Broad shoulders tapering cleanly to a narrow waist, a defined chest, a visible eight-pack abdomen with sharp obliques, long strong arms with clear vein definition, and long lean muscular legs with defined calves. Nothing bulky, everything taut and sculpted. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, autumn maple storm formations in VIVID CRIMSON and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
